phases.name: memory-cycle-probe
phases.description: M1.2 live round probe phase: the single-fixer team (lead + one write-capable fixer from config/rosters/roster.yaml) makes the smallest possible committing change — create one scratch file with one line, git add + git commit on the current sandbox branch — so harvest classifies the range as harvested (not NOCOMMITS), the bundle exists, and the round's L3 assertions (bundle, artifacts incl. solicit-prompt files, memory-retain receipt, re-harvest dedup) are satisfiable at all. The task is deliberately trivial and fully specified so the only nondeterminism is the model's compliance, never the shape of the work.
phases.task: You lead a single-fixer team. Make the smallest possible committing change in this checkout: create a file named MEMORY-CYCLE-PROBE.txt containing a single line — the current date and the word PROBE — then git add + git commit it on the current sandbox branch. Uncommitted work is invisible to harvest, which counts commits on the sandbox branch. Do not push, do not open PRs, do not touch git remotes, CI configuration, or the verification surface. When the commit is made, finish with a JSON object of shape {"changedFiles": ["MEMORY-CYCLE-PROBE.txt"], "result": {"summary": "<one-line summary>"}}.

phases.name: verify-committed
phases.description: Fails the run when the fixer left work uncommitted: harvest counts commits on the sandbox branch, so a dirty tree would harvest nothing new and the probe change would silently vanish. A clean `git status --porcelain` proves every edit the probe phase made is in a commit on sbx/<runId>. Companion phase required by the shipped manifest loader (MIN_PHASES = 2, src/phase-engine/types.ts:57).
command: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo 'uncommitted work remains in the checkout — the probe phase must commit everything on the sandbox branch' >&2; exit 1; }; git log --oneline -1
